memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Problems:
- Atrial fibrillation: Status stable on apixaban 5 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, warfarin (INR target 2-3). Plan: Continue anticoagulation, check INR in 2 weeks, ECG today.
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux: Status mild, pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS. Plan: Continue, review symptoms.
- COPD: Status stable, tiotropium inhaler OD, salbutamol inhaler SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD. Plan: Continue, check spirometry and chest X-ray today, SpO2 at rest.
Weight 68 kg, waist 92 cm (male cut‑off 90 cm – borderline). Diet: Breakfast – low‑salt, whole grain; Lunch – vegetable‑rich, limited fried foods; Dinner – light, early.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Problems:
- Atrial fibrillation: INR 2.4 within target, heart rate 78 bpm. Plan: Continue warfarin 3 mg OD, repeat INR in 4 weeks.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: No heartburn, pantoprazole effective. Plan: Continue current dose.
- COPD: Reports mild dyspnea on climbing stairs, SpO2 92% room air. Plan: Increase budesonide‑formoterol to 2 puffs BD, reinforce inhaler technique, repeat spirometry.
Weight 67.5 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off). Diet advice unchanged.
Due: Next review in 3 months; lipid profile due annually.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Problems:
- Atrial fibrillation: Patient notes occasional palpitations, ECG planned. INR 2.6 stable. Plan: Continue warfarin, apixaban held (not prescribed), bisoprolol unchanged.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: No dyspepsia, pantoprazole effective.
- COPD: Stable, no exacerbations, inhaler technique good.
Weight 67 kg, waist 89 cm (now below male cut‑off). Diet: Continue low‑salt, avoid large evening meals.
Plan: Order lipid profile (annual), ECG today, repeat INR & creatinine in 4 weeks.
Due: Next visit in 3 months.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Problems:
- Atrial fibrillation: Epistaxis raises concern for over‑anticoagulation. INR checked today 3.2 (above target). Plan: Reduce warfarin dose to 2 mg OD, repeat INR in 3 days, assess for any GI bleeding.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux: No symptoms.
- COPD: Stable.
Weight 66.8 kg, waist 88 cm. Diet unchanged.
Due: Next review in 6 weeks.
